question: By what means, addressed to one of fair face, is a certain result said to be attained through mere knowledge and through what has been heard?
premises: An address is made to one of fair face.
Attainment is said to occur by this means.
It is also said to occur by what has been heard.
inference: By mere knowledge and by what has been heard, a certain result is attained, O fair-faced one.
uncertainties: Result attained not specified in this verse
plain_english: By this mere knowledge and by what has been heard, O fair-faced one, a certain result is attained.
